text: Olayan M. Alwetaid, the CEO of stc Group, was appointed to Telefónica's board as a proprietary director on 26 February 2025, on the proposal of significant shareholder Green Bridge Investment Company SCS / Stc Group.
short: stc's CEO sits on Telefónica's board as a proprietary director at stc's proposal.

source.name: Telefónica: Annual Report on Corporate Governance 2025 (PDF), board appointments section and 'positions of Directors with significant shareholders' table
source.quote: the appointment by co-optation, on February 26, 2025, of Mr. Olayan M. Alwetaid as Proprietary Director, upon proposal of the significant shareholder Green Bridge Investment Company SCS / Stc Group
source.note: The same report's related-party table describes Mr. Alwetaid as 'CEO of Saudi Telecom Company (STC)' and his board biography says 'Currently, he is the CEO of the stc Group since 2021'.
